svg.title: Fig. 1: proxy P and true T for A0 and A2″, by training state
svg.text: Fig. 1: proxy P and true T for A0 and A2″, by training state
D1→D1: true T, leg progress vs KL
D2→D2: true T, leg progress vs KL
Means pooled over seeds (8 eval episodes per seed per mark); band = 95% bootstrap over seeds, episodes
resampled within seeds (B = 10,000). Thin lines = one seed; hollow = collapsed A2″ seed-ckpt (§9 (1)).
Ticks above P: first mark a hack type is present in A0 above R0 after Holm (dark = seeds pooled,
light = one seed alone, labelled type·seed). P and T are stacked panels, not two axes.
x = KL: init rebuilt from each run's seed with its training thread count and checked by hash (one hash
per seed, shared by A0 and A2″); verified by reproducibility, not against a stored step-0 checkpoint.
Runs left out of the KL panel: none.
